title: pachypleuria pusilloides
intro: Pachypleuria pusilloides, commonly known as the Pachypleuria fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The health benefits of Pachypleuria pusilloides are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, immunomodulatory, and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
